risks.title: AI server demand concentrated among few large customers

quote.risk_heading: The nature of the demand for AI solutions may have adverse effects on our operating performance.

risks.title: Component supply shortages and cost inflation from concentrated vendors

quote.risk_heading: Our relationships with our product and component vendors could harm our business by adversely affecting product availability, delivery, reliability, and cost.

risks.title: Substantial indebtedness constrains cash flow and financial flexibility

quote.risk_heading: We have outstanding indebtedness and may incur additional debt in the future, which could adversely affect our financial condition.

risks.title: Tariffs, trade disputes and adverse macroeconomic conditions

quote.risk_heading: Adverse global economic conditions may harm our business and result in reduced net revenue and profitability.

risks.title: Controlling stockholders dominate voting through multi-class share structure

quote.risk_heading: Our multi-class common stock structure with different voting rights may adversely affect the trading price of the Class C Common Stock.
